# CeremonyVerse

> CeremonyVerse is a US-based Indian wedding shopping concierge that sources authentic bridal lehengas, sherwanis, jewelry, and ceremonial items directly from India to the USA. Live video verification, vetted artisan partners, milestone-based payment protection, and 100% fit guarantee. Founded by Bhamini after coordinating multiple family weddings. Serves all 50 US states.

## About

CeremonyVerse eliminates risk, confusion, and logistics when sourcing authentic Indian wedding outfits, jewelry, and accessories directly from India to the United States. Core differentiators: live video verification of fabrics, vetted artisan partners across India, full-party coordination, US trust + India access, and transparent itemized pricing (15-20% sourcing fee, no hidden markups).

- [About CeremonyVerse](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/about/): Founder story, mission, and how the concierge model works
- [How It Works](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/how-it-works/): Step-by-step process from consultation to delivery
- [Services Overview](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/services/): Style Guide ($149), Guided Sourcing ($599+), Full Bridal Concierge ($1,499+)
- [Pricing](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/pricing/): Transparent tiered pricing with itemized quotes
- [FAQ](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/faq/): 15+ questions on trust, sizing, pricing, shipping, and cultural traditions

## Core Services

- [Bridal Lehengas](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/services/bridal-lehengas/): Custom bridal lehengas sourced from Surat and Kolkata, with live video approval and 100% fit guarantee
- [Groom Sherwanis](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/groom/): Sherwanis, bandhgalas, and Indo-western suits for grooms
- [Bridesmaid Coordination](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/bridesmaids/): Coordinated lehengas for bridal parties across multiple states
- [Family Outfits](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/family/): Outfits for parents, siblings, and extended family
- [Jewelry](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/jewelry/): Polki, kundan, and temple jewelry sourced directly from India
- [Ceremonial Items](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/ceremonial/): Haldi, mehndi, sangeet, and baraat ceremonial items
- [Welcome Bags](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/welcomebags/): Custom welcome bags for wedding guests
- [Return Gifts](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/gifts/): Bulk return gifts from India
- [Intercultural Weddings](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/services/intercultural-indian-weddings/): Coordination for intercultural Indian weddings

## Key Statistics & Proof Points

- Coordinated 14 bridesmaids + 14 groomsmen across multiple states
- Handled 4-day destination weddings (Mexico, India)
- 100% fit guarantee with alteration cost coverage up to $150 per garment
- Typical client savings: 30-50% vs US Indian boutiques
- Production timeline: 4-6 months for custom bridal lehengas (14-20 weeks production + shipping)
- All 50 US states served
- Founder Bhamini has direct relationships with artisan partners across Surat, Kolkata, Varanasi, Jaipur, Kanchipuram, Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore

## Trust & Verification

- Vetted artisan partners with personal relationships (not random Instagram sellers)
- Live video shopping sessions with HD verification of fabrics, embroidery, and color
- Milestone-based payment protection (25% deposit, 35% after fabric approval, 30% after inspection, 10% on delivery)
- Pre-shipping inspection and quality verification
- Full insurance on all shipments
- 100% fit guarantee with alteration cost coverage
- Transparent, itemized pricing with no hidden markups
